item.tib: gshen gyi dgon sde spyi dang bshad sgrub kyi grwa sde so so'i bslab bya'i bca' yig gi rim pa ngo mtshar gzugs mang gsal ba'i me long
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni byang pa khro tshang gi gdung son grub chen nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyi gdan sa 'dra yul chu mig dgon chu med bsam gtan gling gi mkhan chen dam pa bla ma g.yung drung rgyal mtshan gyi thugs bzhed ngor khod spungs dbra zhig ston pas 'phral bris su byas pa'o//
